items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So Mister Wright says, "You know, Cab Calloway fined you."

ctx.x: We did the big ones and the small ones. We'd go out there... I just want to say this. You see, what...
So Mister Wright says, "You know, Cab Calloway fined you." I asked him, said, "Give me a loan," so he gives me, I think, thirty dollars. So I am getting a hundred and a

quarter. He said, "Now, you know you're fined, so don't (?) yourself." I said, "Fined? Did you fine anybody else?" He said, "No, he didn't fine nobody else." But payday comes, and I got my money, and I was twenty dollars out. I said, "Cab, why did you fine me and you didn't fine the rest of them guys that was late?" He said, "Well, you know better." I said, "I know better? Well, okay. I'm gonna quit the band." He says, "Oh, man. Go on and ...(??)... Go and work. Don't come at me with that kind of shit, that talk."
